common.offline: You're offline. This needs a connection; it will work again once you're back.

onboarding.documentTitle: Pay any spaza from any wallet
onboarding.body: Take payments with just a QR code. No card machine, very little data, and it keeps working when the signal drops.

setup.title: Set up your shop
setup.nameHint: Customers see this when they pay.

existing.title: This phone already runs {{shop}}
existing.description: A new shop replaces it on this phone, and this phone can't open the old one again.
existing.replace: Set up a new shop instead

wallet.nameHint: Just your wallet name: the part after the slash.
wallet.fullHint: It starts with $ or https://. Find it in your wallet app.

poster.title: Your QR poster
poster.hint: Print it on A5 and put it where customers can scan it.

connect.title: Connecting your shop
connect.failed: This link didn't work. Set up the shop again or ask for a new link.

pay.subtitle: Pay with any wallet
pay.walletHint: Saved on this phone for next time.

notFound.title: Shop not found
notFound.description: Check the QR code, or ask the shop for their link.

quote.title: Confirm payment
quote.includes: Includes all fees and the exchange rate.

customer.title: Pay a shop
customer.scan: Point your phone's camera at the shop's QR code. It opens the payment screen, no app needed.
customer.codeHint: It's printed on the shop's poster, under the QR code.

receipt.title: Payment

waiting.title: Waiting for approval
waiting.description: Approve the payment in your wallet to finish.

receipt.callbackError: We couldn't confirm your approval yet. Check your wallet before trying again.

empty.title: No payments yet
empty.description: Payments appear here the moment they land, and your phone can read them out.

setUp.title: No shop on this phone yet
setUp.description: Setting up takes under two minutes: your wallet address and a shop name.

voice.label: Read payments out loud
voice.unsupported: This phone can't read out loud.

unauthorized.title: This phone is signed out of the shop
unauthorized.description: Open your shop's link again, or set up the shop again.

failures.consent_declined: The payment was declined in the wallet. No money was taken.
failures.consent_invalid: The approval couldn't be verified, so no money was taken.
failures.consent_timeout: The payment wasn't approved in time. No money was taken.
failures.quote_expired: The price expired before the payment was approved. Please try again.
failures.insufficient_funds: The wallet doesn't have enough money for this payment.
failures.grant_limit: The payment is more than the wallet approved.
failures.payment_failed: The payment failed. No money was taken.
failures.timeout: The money is taking long to arrive. Check the wallet before paying again.

tab.title: My tabs

empty.title: No open tabs
empty.description: Open a tab at your local spaza once, then pay with a tap, even when there's no signal.

tab.howToOpen: Scan a shop's QR code, then choose Open a tab at this shop.
tab.openHere: Open a tab at this shop

open.title: Open a tab
open.intro: Pay {{shop}} with a tap, even when neither phone has signal. You approve a weekly limit once, in your own wallet.
open.labelHint: The shop sees this next to your tab.
open.capHint: The most this tab can take in a week. Your wallet holds it to that.
open.offline: Opening a tab needs signal once. After that it works offline.

detail.waiting: Approve the weekly limit in your wallet to start using this tab.
detail.failed: This tab wasn't opened. No money was taken.
detail.callbackError: We couldn't confirm your approval. Check your wallet, then try opening the tab again.
detail.otherPhone: This tab was opened on another phone, so only that phone can pay with it.
detail.howToPay: To pay, ask the shop for a tab sale and scan the QR code they show you.
detail.noPayments: No payments on this tab yet.

settings.title: Settings
settings.simulateOfflineHint: Shows the offline tab flow without airplane mode. Nothing reaches the server until you switch it off.

offline.banner: You're offline. AnyPay keeps working and syncs when you're back.

error.title: Something went wrong
error.description: Reload the page to try again.

walletAddress.format: Wallet addresses start with $ or https://

shopName.characters: Remove the hidden or special characters

errors.idempotencyKey: Something went wrong. Please try again.

api.network_error: No connection. Check your data and try again.
api.wallet_host_not_allowed: AnyPay can't use wallets from that provider yet.
api.wallet_address_invalid: That isn't a valid wallet address.
api.wallet_not_found: There's no wallet at that address.
api.rate_limited: Too many tries. Wait a minute, then try again.
api.open_payments_unavailable: The wallet provider isn't answering. Try again soon.
api.open_payments_not_configured: Payments aren't switched on for this AnyPay server yet.
api.merchant_unauthorized: This phone isn't signed in to the shop.
api.invalid_amount: Enter an amount more than zero.
api.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
api.voucher_invalid: This voucher wasn't signed by the customer's phone.

tabLabel.required: Enter a name the shop will know you by

sale.title: Tab sale
sale.hint: For customers with a tab at your shop. Works with no signal.
sale.askCustomer: The customer scans this, approves, and shows you their QR.
sale.syncFailed: Couldn't update your customers' tabs. Using the ones on this phone.

noTabs.title: No tabs yet
noTabs.description: When a customer opens a tab at your shop, you can sell to them here, even with no signal.

approve.title: Pay with your tab
approve.noTab: You don't have a tab at this shop on this phone. Open one while you have signal.
approve.capReached: This is more than what's left on your tab this week.
approve.expired: This request is too old. Ask the shop for a new one.
approve.invalid: This isn't a valid AnyPay sale.

reasons.tab_inactive: The tab is no longer active
reasons.grant_limit: The customer's wallet refused: over the weekly limit
reasons.insufficient_funds: Not enough money in the customer's wallet
reasons.invalid: Not signed by the customer's phone

check.other_shop: This QR is for another shop.
check.unknown_tab: This customer's tab isn't on this phone yet. Connect once to update your tabs, then scan again.
check.invalid: This QR wasn't signed by the customer's phone.
check.expired: This approval is too old (over 72 hours).
check.cap_reached: This is more than what's left on the customer's tab this week.
check.duplicate: Already saved: this sale won't be paid twice.

scan.title: Scan a QR code
scan.hint: Point the camera at the QR code.
scan.noCamera: The camera isn't available. Paste the link instead.
